Instead, it proceeded with the assumption that the correct individual was the one born in Holley, New York, based on the first search result. This assumption could lead to an incorrect resolution of the problem if the user intended to inquire about the William W. Blair born in Ontario. Proper disambiguation should have been performed before proceeding further.
